artifacts.title: Draft: Simple PRD template
artifacts.content:
Product requirements
Product: AI Governance registry and review workspace.
Problem and users
Problem and users: Merlion Services staff need a safe internal registry; requesters, assigned reviewers and admins need controlled review and oversight.
Scope
In scope: Registration, tool eligibility, review, versioning, access control and audit.
Out of scope: AI gateway, browser monitoring and automated legal compliance.
Requirements
R1: Register purpose, owner, tool and data classification; exclude raw customer data.
R2: Approve only cases using an active allowed tool.
R3: Assigned reviewers approve, reject or request changes; deny self-approval and bind approval to the exact submitted version.
R4: A change to purpose, tool or data classification invalidates approval and requires new review.
R5: Enforce World and role access server-side: requester owns case, assigned reviewer reads it, admins manage configuration and audit; deny unrelated roles and cross-World access.
R6: Append-only audit records actor, action, time and version; approval and audit write are atomic. Retention TBD.
Acceptance tests
ID	Requirement	Action / setup	Expected result
TC01	R1	Register purpose, owner, tool and classification; attempt to enter raw customer data.	Required metadata is recorded; raw customer data is excluded.
TC02	R2	Submit a case with an inactive or disallowed tool for approval.	Approval is denied.
TC03	R3	As assigned reviewer, approve, reject and request changes on separate submitted cases.	Each selected decision is recorded against its submitted case.
TC04	R3	As case owner, attempt to approve own submission.	Approval is denied; case remains unapproved.
TC05	R3	Review version 1, then submit version 2; attempt to approve version 1.	Stale approval is denied; version 2 requires review.
TC06	R4	Separately change purpose, tool and data classification on approved cases.	Each change invalidates approval and requires new review.
TC07	R5	Attempt case access as another requester, an unassigned reviewer and a user in another World.	Server denies each request; no case data is returned.
TC08	R5	In the same World, read a case as its owner and assigned reviewer; manage configuration and audit as admin.	Owner and assigned reviewer can read the case; admin can manage configuration and audit.
TC09	R6	Approve a case; inspect audit fields and attempt edit/delete. Repeat with audit write forced to fail.	Audit has actor, action, time and version; edits/deletes fail. On write failure neither approval nor audit entry commits.
TC10	R6	With retention TBD, inspect policy; after a fixed retention revision, test records just inside and beyond its boundary.	No duration is assumed while TBD; after revision, treatment matches the specified boundary.
Proposed success measures
Proposed measures: registration completeness, review turnaround and denied unauthorized access; targets unconfirmed.
Open decisions
Open decisions: audit retention TBD; launch date TBD; budget TBD.

artifacts.title: Draft: Simple PRD template
artifacts.content:
Product requirements
Product: AI Governance registry and review workspace
Problem and users
Problem and users: Merlion Services needs an internal AI-use registry and review workspace for staff, assigned reviewers and admins.
Scope
In scope: Registration, tool eligibility, versioned review, case access and audit.
Out of scope: AI gateway, browser monitoring and automated legal compliance.
Requirements
R1: Register purpose, owner, tool and data classification; exclude raw customer data.
R2: Approve only active allowed tools.
R3: Assigned reviewers approve, reject or request changes; deny self-approval and bind approval to the exact submitted version.
R4: Purpose, tool or data-classification changes invalidate approval and require new review.
R5: Enforce World and roles server-side: requester owns case, assigned reviewer reads it, admins manage configuration and audit; deny unrelated and cross-World access.
R6: Append-only audit records actor, action, time and version; approval and audit write are atomic. Retention TBD.
Acceptance tests
ID	Requirement	Action / setup	Expected result
TC01	R1	Register purpose, owner, tool and classification; attempt raw customer data entry.	Required metadata is recorded; raw customer data is excluded.
TC02	R2	Submit a case using an inactive or disallowed tool for approval.	Approval is denied.
TC03	R3	Assigned reviewer separately approves, rejects and requests changes on submitted cases.	Each decision is recorded against its submitted case version.
TC04	R3	Requester assigned as reviewer attempts to approve own case.	Approval is denied; case remains unapproved.
TC05	R3	Reviewer attempts approval of a stale submitted version after a newer version exists.	Stale approval is denied; the current version requires review.
TC06	R4	Separately change purpose, tool and data classification on approved cases.	Each change invalidates approval and requires new review.
TC07	R5	Other requester, unassigned reviewer and cross-World user attempt case access.	Server denies each attempt.
TC08	R5	Owner and assigned reviewer read their case; same-World admin manages configuration and audit.	Authorized reads and admin operations succeed.
TC09	R6	Approve a case, inspect audit fields and attempt modification; inject audit-write failure on another approval.	Actor, action, time and version are recorded; modification is denied; failed write rolls back approval.
TC10	R6	Check retention while TBD; after a fixed revision sets it, test records just inside and beyond the boundary.	No duration is assumed while TBD; after revision, retention follows the specified boundary.
Proposed success measures
Proposed measures: registration completeness, review turnaround and denied unauthorized attempts; targets unconfirmed.
Open decisions
Open decisions: audit retention TBD; launch date TBD; budget TBD.
